game_concept: A adventure race set in Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge, a ridge known for yetis: the ice axe ranger must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Palindrome Gate: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge: a ridge known for yetis
core_gameplay_loop: In Yeti Ridge, repeat each round: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ice axe ranger ahead. Then check the gate value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ice ladder by solving code steps involving gate that move the ice axe ranger forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ice ladder first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Palindrome Gate
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Palindrome Gate' (Week 8 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Yeti Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Yeti Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
